A natural (an Ace with a ten-value card) pays 3:2 unless the dealer also has one, which is a push. Otherwise you act first with hit, stand, double, or split pairs. Going over 21 busts. The dealer draws to 17 and stands on all 17s. A win pays 1:1, and equal totals push. Set your bet at the table and deal when you're ready.
